plugins/presencehabituelle/plugin_info/c.À l'ajout d'une commande, ses changement: When a command is added, its state changes are imported from the Jeedom history over this number of days (if the command is historized). Default 90.
plugins/presencehabituelle/plugin_info/c.Les changements d'état plus anciens sont: Older state changes are deleted every night: habits follow the season. Default 90, minimum 7.
plugins/presencehabituelle/plugin_info/c.Un allumage plus long est pris pour une: A longer switch-on is taken as a missed switch-off (box stopped, bridge offline): it is discarded, and the days it touches are not counted for its group. Default 18.

plugins/presencehabituelle/core/class/pr.Période illisible (attendu AAAA-MM-JJ HH: Unreadable period (expected YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM → YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM)
plugins/presencehabituelle/core/class/pr.La commande d'absence doit être binaire: The absence command must be binary or numeric (true during the absence): a text mode will not do, use a binary virtual
plugins/presencehabituelle/core/class/pr.Commande d'absence numérique lissée : ré: Smoothed numeric absence command: set its smoothing to "None" (command configuration, History tab) or use a binary virtual
plugins/presencehabituelle/core/class/pr.Image refusée : JPEG de 4000 × 4000 pixe: Image refused: JPEG of 4000 × 4000 pixels at most
plugins/presencehabituelle/core/class/pr.Écriture impossible sur la box (disque p: Cannot write on the box (disk full?): nothing was saved

plugins/presencehabituelle/core/ajax/pre.Choix des commandes illisible : rien n'a: Unreadable command choice: nothing was saved

plugins/presencehabituelle/desktop/js/pr.Réponse illisible : session expirée ? Re: Unreadable answer: session expired? Reload the page.
plugins/presencehabituelle/desktop/js/pr.Déconseillé : pas un geste de présence: Not recommended: not a sign of presence
plugins/presencehabituelle/desktop/js/pr.Rien à reprendre : l’analyse part de l’e: Nothing to import: the analysis starts when saved
plugins/presencehabituelle/desktop/js/pr.Jeedom remplace ses valeurs par une moye: Jeedom replaces its values with an hourly average after a few hours: only the last hours are imported. Set its smoothing to “None” (command configuration, History tab).
plugins/presencehabituelle/desktop/js/pr.Aucune lumière ni aucun volet trouvé : r: No light or shutter found: set the generic type of their state commands, or show the other commands.
plugins/presencehabituelle/desktop/js/pr.Pas encore assez de données (un jour ent: Not enough data yet (at least one full day).
plugins/presencehabituelle/desktop/js/pr.Allumée au moins une fois à chaque heure: On at least once at every hour.
plugins/presencehabituelle/desktop/js/pr.heures où elle l’est au plus 10 % des jo: hours when it is on at most 10 % of days
plugins/presencehabituelle/desktop/js/pr.Exceptions : jours loin de la moitié cen: Exceptions: days far from the middle half, by more than 30 min and by more than 1.5 times its spread (whichever is larger).
plugins/presencehabituelle/desktop/js/pr.Ouverture du matin : seulement si le vol: Morning opening: only if the shutter was closed at 04:00. A partial closing (against the sun) does not count.
plugins/presencehabituelle/desktop/js/pr.Journée de 04 h à 04 h. Week-end : matin: Day from 04:00 to 04:00. Weekend: Saturday and Sunday mornings (04:00-16:00), Friday and Saturday evenings (16:00-04:00).
plugins/presencehabituelle/desktop/js/pr.Effacer les changements d’état relevés e: Erase the recorded state changes and computed trends? The choice of commands is kept; the Jeedom history is not imported again.

plugins/presencehabituelle/desktop/js/pr.Cliquez les coins de la pièce, puis « Te: Click the corners of the room, then “Finish the shape”.
plugins/presencehabituelle/desktop/js/pr.Cliquez les coins de la zone (ex. une ch: Click the corners of the zone (e.g. a guest room), then “Finish the shape”.
plugins/presencehabituelle/desktop/js/pr.Cliquez les deux bouts du passage (une p: Click both ends of the passage (a door, a corridor, the top of a staircase).
plugins/presencehabituelle/desktop/js/pr.Cliquez une pastille (elle retourne dans: Click a marker (it goes back to “Not on the plan”), a room, a passage or a zone to remove it.
Draw at least two rooms first.
plugins/presencehabituelle/desktop/js/pr.Fois où une lumière de la seconde pièce: Times a light of the second room turns on less than 3 min after a light of the first one turns off.
plugins/presencehabituelle/desktop/js/pr.Glissez une pastille pour la déplacer ;: Drag a marker to move it; click a command under “Not on the plan”, then the plan, to place it; click a room to rename it.
plugins/presencehabituelle/desktop/js/pr.Image enregistrée. Enregistrez le plan p: Image saved. Save the plan to keep the floor.
plugins/presencehabituelle/desktop/js/pr.Image illisible (prenez une photo ou une: Unreadable image (use a photo or a screenshot: PNG, JPEG…)
plugins/presencehabituelle/desktop/js/pr.Leurs positions actuelles sont remplacée: Their current positions are replaced. They follow the design's proportions: use the design's background as the floor image, or an image with the same proportions.
plugins/presencehabituelle/desktop/js/pr.Pas d’image pour cet étage : « Image… »: No image for this floor: “Image…” to upload one (photo, screenshot), or draw on the grid.
plugins/presencehabituelle/desktop/js/pr.Reprendre les positions d’un design…: Take the positions from a design…
plugins/presencehabituelle/desktop/js/pr.Supprimer cet étage, son image, ses pièc: Delete this floor, its image, rooms, passages, zones and the positions on it? (applied when the plan is saved)
plugins/presencehabituelle/desktop/js/pr.Un passage relie deux pièces différentes: A passage links two different rooms.
plugins/presencehabituelle/desktop/js/pr.Une autre pièce porte ce nom : leurs lam: Another room has this name: their lamps will be analysed together.
plugins/presencehabituelle/desktop/js/pr.commandes suivies trouvées. Les placer s: followed commands found. Place them on the floor
plugins/presencehabituelle/desktop/js/pr.une pièce d’un autre étage pour un escal: a room on another floor for a staircase

plugins/presencehabituelle/desktop/php/p.Tout est calculé sur cette box : le plug: Everything is computed on this box: the plugin sends nothing to anyone, and only administrators can see the trends (they are part of the Jeedom backups, like the rest of the database). For now the plugin draws from your history the trends, the exceptions and what never happens: it does not switch on or close anything yet.
plugins/presencehabituelle/desktop/php/p.Cochez les lumières et les volets à anal: Tick the lights and shutters to analyse. Plugs and media are offered unticked: a plug may power a fridge or a router, that is not presence. Sensors are not used: they say nothing about what you do.
plugins/presencehabituelle/desktop/php/p.Groupe : les lampes d'un même groupe son: Group: lamps of the same group are analysed together (a room). Empty = the lamp alone.
plugins/presencehabituelle/desktop/php/p.Vos absences (et toute période où une si: Your absences (and any period when a simulation was running) distort the trends: those days are not counted.
plugins/presencehabituelle/desktop/php/p.Commande info binaire ou numérique, vrai: Binary or numeric info command that is true during an absence (e.g. a binary virtual “Away” or “Holiday”; a text mode will not do): its active periods are excluded. Optional.
plugins/presencehabituelle/desktop/php/p.Une par ligne : AAAA-MM-JJ HH:MM → AAAA-: One per line: YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM → YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM (time is optional). Any day touched is excluded entirely.
plugins/presencehabituelle/desktop/php/p.Facultatif. Un plan par étage : déposez-: Optional. One plan per floor: upload its image, place the followed lights and shutters, draw the rooms (they group the lamps inside them, unless a group is typed), the passages between rooms (doors, corridors, staircases, including from one floor to another) and the zones to exclude (neither analysed nor simulated). The image stays on the box, visible to administrators only.
